en.html:
CYRIS
Archive Settings Sign in
Settings

How cyris runs

Model Digest Pipeline Notifications Sources Tracking

Model

The models the next run calls, and how it uses your votes.

Loading settings…

Provider

Embedding provider

The embedder vote similarity compares articles with. Its similarity cutoff comes with the model, so it is not set here.

Checked with one real call when vote similarity is on.

Drop candidates close to an article you voted down. Preview what it would drop with cyris vote-sim.

How many of your most recent votes on each side a run compares against.

Digest

When issues are published, what each one holds, and how large its text reads.

Loading settings…

Publish hours

Whole hours from 0 to 23; half hours are refused.

The clock the publish hours are read in.

Detected from this browser, and not saved yet.

The language headlines and summaries are written in.

Your tone or focus for the summaries, in your own words; empty means none.

Applies to every page within a minute, issues already published too.

Put first the items on topics you voted up, and on topics that share a name with them. The order only moves items; nothing is left out for it.

Who decides which items come first: your topic votes, or Clef reading the votes nearest each item. An issue Clef cannot fully score uses your topic votes.

Clef needs vote similarity on, under Model.

Clef needs a Workers AI token: set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN (or CLOUDFLARE_EMBEDDING_API_TOKEN).

Give each article from a source you follow a short explanation of what it is, as read articles get. Off shows the start of its own text.

A vote counts half as much after this many days, so a preference fades unless you vote again.

Topics seen within this many days are current: new articles can join them, and a name many of them share counts for less in the order. An upvote slows how fast a topic leaves the list new articles can join; the effect fades with the vote half-life, and never lasts past three times this many days after the topic last appeared.

Pipeline

How far back each run looks, how much it reads, and where it cuts.

Loading settings…

How far back a run looks for articles.

How many of the window's newest articles, by publish time, one run scores and digests across all sources.

Two or more articles on one topic scoring at least this share the Top story.

Characters read

More costs more per call.

More costs more tokens and time. Default keeps each provider's own level, except low on OpenAI; Workers AI always runs at low, and Save checks the level with one call.

Notifications

Where a finished issue is announced.

Loading settings…

To change it, paste the whole URL; it is saved once Discord confirms it exists. Turn off clears it: runs then finish without a message.

Notifications are off.

Leave it empty to send no mail. It must be a verified destination in Cloudflare Email Routing, and is saved once a test message reaches it.

An address on your Email Routing domain.

Sources

The feeds and newsletter senders the next run reads.

NameTypeLaneFeed or senderTags
Loading sources…

Tracking

Topics each issue lists every close article for, under Tracking.

NameDescriptionThresholdEmbedding model
Loading topics…

zh-Hant.html:
CYRIS
過往精選 設定 登入
設定

cyris 如何運作

模型 精選 處理流程 通知 來源 追蹤

模型

下一期會呼叫的模型，以及如何運用你的投票。

正在載入設定…

供應商

嵌入模型供應商

投票相似度用這個嵌入模型比對文章。相似度門檻由模型決定，不在這裡設定。

開啟投票相似度時，會實際呼叫一次來檢查。

排除與你投少看的文章相近的候選文章。可用 cyris vote-sim 預覽會排除哪些。

每期比對時，多看和少看各取你最近的幾票。

精選

每期何時發布、包含什麼內容，以及文字顯示多大。

正在載入設定…

發布時間

填入 0 到 23 的整點；不接受半點。

發布時間採用的時區。

從這個瀏覽器偵測到，尚未儲存。

標題和摘要使用的語言。

用自己的話描述摘要的語氣或重點；留空表示不指定。

一分鐘內套用到每個頁面，已發布的精選也適用。

把你投多看的主題，以及與它們同名的主題排在前面。排序只會調整順序，不會因此移除任何項目。

決定哪些項目排在前面：依你的主題投票，或由 Clef 參考與各項目最相近的投票。Clef 無法完整評分的那一期，會改用你的主題投票。

Clef 需要先在「模型」開啟投票相似度。

Clef 需要 Workers AI 權杖，請設定 CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID 和 CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN（或 CLOUDFLARE_EMBEDDING_API_TOKEN）。

為你關注的來源中每篇文章加上簡短說明，如同精讀文章。關閉時顯示文章本身的開頭。

每一票經過這個天數後，權重只剩一半；除非再次投票，偏好會逐漸淡去。

在這個天數內出現過的主題算是現行主題，新文章可以加入；許多主題共用一個名稱時，這個名稱在排序中份量較低。投多看會讓主題較慢離開可加入清單；此效果隨投票半衰期減弱，最長不超過主題最後出現後此天數的三倍。

處理流程

每期往回找多久、讀多少內容，以及在哪裡截斷。

正在載入設定…

每期往回找多久以內的文章。

每期從所有來源中，依發布時間取時間範圍內最新的幾篇文章，評分後編入精選。

同一主題有兩篇以上文章達到這個分數時，會一起列為頭條。

讀取字數

讀得越多，每次呼叫的費用越高。

越高越耗 token 與時間。「預設」沿用各供應商的等級，OpenAI 則用低；Workers AI 一律用低。按「儲存」時會呼叫一次來檢查等級。

通知

每期完成後，要在哪裡通知。

正在載入設定…

如要更改，請貼上完整網址，Discord 確認網址存在後才會儲存。按「關閉通知」會清除網址，之後每期完成時不再發送訊息。

通知已關閉。

留空就不寄信。必須是 Cloudflare Email Routing 中已驗證的收件地址，測試信寄達後才會儲存。

請填寫 Email Routing 網域上的地址。

來源

下一期會讀取的資訊來源與電子報寄件者。

名稱類型處理方式資訊來源或寄件者標籤
正在載入來源…

追蹤

每期會在「追蹤」下列出與這些主題相近的所有文章。

名稱說明門檻嵌入模型
正在載入主題…
